scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-targets && cargo check -p nvstraps-core --no-default-features
scripts.build:firmware: cargo build -p nvstraps-uefi --release --target x86_64-unknown-uefi && cargo run -p nvstraps-ffs -- pack target/x86_64-unknown-uefi/release/NvStrapsReBar.efi target/x86_64-unknown-uefi/release/NvStrapsReBar.ffs && cargo run -p nvstraps-ffs -- inspect target/x86_64-unknown-uefi/release/NvStrapsReBar.ffs
scripts.check:firmware: cargo test -p nvstraps-ffs && npm run build:firmware
